WITH RECURSIVE months AS (
    SELECT '2019-01-01' AS mth, 1 AS month_num
    UNION ALL
    SELECT m.mth, m.month_num + 1
    FROM months m
    WHERE m.month_num < 12
),
product_starts AS (
    SELECT product_id, qty AS start_inventory
    FROM monthly_budget
    WHERE mth = '2018-12-01'
),
monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT product_id, mth, qty AS sales
    FROM monthly_budget
    WHERE mth >= '2019-01-01' AND mth <= '2019-12-01'
),
sales_by_product_month AS (
    SELECT m.mth, ps.product_id, ms.sales
    FROM months m
    JOIN monthly_sales ms ON ms.mth = m.mth
    JOIN product_starts ps ON ps.product_id = ms.product_id
),
-- First pass: calculate ending inventory from previous month
inventory_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        ps.product_id,
        m.mth AS mth,
        ps.start_inventory AS beginning_inventory
    FROM product_starts ps
    JOIN months m ON m.month_num = 1
)
